faqs: What is Daraz product hunting and why do sellers need it?

Daraz product hunting is researching items with strong buyer demand, manageable competition, and workable margins after Daraz commission and fees. Zetawala's free tool helps Pakistan sellers validate niches before sourcing stock.
What profit margin is good for Daraz Pakistan products?
Aim for roughly 30–50% net after category commission, the ~1.25% payment fee, packaging, shipping, and provincial VAT on Daraz service fees. Thin margins break during mega-sale discounts.
How does product hunting improve Best Seller Rank on Daraz?
High-demand, low-competition products convert faster. Sales velocity signals the Daraz algorithm, which can lift organic rank and BSR when listings also have solid titles, images, and Content Score.
Should I hunt for FBM or FBD (Fulfilled by Daraz) products?

Lightweight, fast movers often perform well on FBD with the Daraz Express badge. Bulkier or test SKUs may start on FBM until demand is proven. Match hunting criteria to your fulfillment model in Seller Center.
How do I judge competitor strength when hunting Daraz products?
Review the top page-one listings: ratings, review volume, Content Score gaps, pricing, and stock movement. Weak photos or thin descriptions are openings for a stronger optimized listing.
What makes a winning product for Daraz 11.11 or mega campaigns?
Impulse-friendly items with enough margin to absorb mandatory campaign discounts while staying profitable. Broad appeal and reliable supply matter more than one-off trendy SKUs.

How do I write a Daraz product title that ranks?

Start with brand (if branded/Mall) or the core product keyword, then add differentiating attributes (size, material, use case). Avoid spammy repeats; optimize for humans and the Daraz search algorithm.
Can keyword stuffing get my Daraz title rejected?
Yes. Phrases like 'mouse wireless mouse cheap mouse' hurt trust and can fail QC. Use natural language with high-intent terms once each where they fit.
Should the brand name come first in a Daraz title?
For known brands and Daraz Mall items, yes—lead with the brand. For No Brand/generic goods, lead with the primary search keyword buyers type.

Minor refinements are fine; major keyword swaps can disrupt indexing and temporary rank. Preserve proven core terms when possible.
Can I use pipes, hyphens, or emojis in Daraz titles?
Hyphens and pipes help readability. Skip emoji spam and promotional symbols—Daraz QC often rejects cluttered or claim-heavy titles.

faqs: How does the Daraz profit calculator handle commission?

How is provincial VAT calculated on Daraz Pakistan fees?
VAT typically applies to Daraz service fees (commission, payment, related charges), not the full retail price. Rates differ by province (e.g. PRA ~16% in Punjab).
What is the Daraz payment handling fee?
Daraz commonly charges about 1.25% payment handling on successful order value covering card, transfer, and COD-related processing.
Are there extra FBD fees beyond commission?
FBD can include inbound/outbound handling and storage by volume. You may save personal packaging costs and gain Express conversion benefits—model both sides.

How do returns affect Daraz profit margins?
Returns can erase packaging costs and risk damaged stock even when some fees are adjusted. Factor return rate into your calculator assumptions before scaling.
